domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India/export revenue split could be retrieved: jaquar.com homepage and /en/media-room contain only marketing text ("60+ Countries Presence", "Jaquar World ... showroom") with no financials; DuckDuckGo search tool returned connection errors on all three attempts, so no tender or MCA filing page was reachable. Domestic supply is therefore evidenced only by the company's own site claim of an India dealer network ("Purchase our products from Jaquar authorized dealers only. Find a Store"), which under Rule 5 is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue and export value: null (not public in sources read).
note: Legal entity exists and is active: JAQUAR AND COMPANY PRIVATE LIMITED, C-20, SMA Co-operative Industrial Estate, G.T. Karnal Road (address as printed in customs records). Important identity point: the batch name 'JAQUAR & CO. PVT. LTD' is the UK/overseas distribution arm (Leeds LS4 2AH; also Heathrow), i.e. the BUYER in the customs records — the Indian manufacturer-exporter is JAQUAR AND COMPANY PRIVATE LIMITED. Role: manufacturer (own plants, own brands Jaquar/Artize/Essco) plus in-house trading of Chinese components (imports from Xiamen Canpro, Zhejiang Ferrics, Guangdong Uncommon, HS 84029090/39174000/40169350/39229000). HS check: declared 392210; 691010; 691090; 848180 — actual shipment HS codes seen are 84818020, 39221000, 84819090, 39229000; 691010/691090 (ceramic sanitaryware) did not appear in the rows read, so the declared set is partly unverified rather than wrong; no HS-based rejection applies per Rule 3. PAN AAACJ2324F and state 'Chandigarh' were not verifiable from any source read (customs address is Delhi/G.T. Karnal Road) — recorded as claimed, not confirmed. Export status is confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS; domestic status stays declared_only because no GST turnover, tender or contract record was reachable within the tool budget.
